subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR that applies the sidebar image-size parity fix, replace it with a local narrow PR plus browser proof, or reject that fix shape?
rationale: The issue is valid from source, but an open linked PR already owns the closing path and ClawSweeper should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Review linked PR first
options.body: Review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/744, require real Web UI proof, and land it if the proof and merge state are acceptable.

options.title: Replace with narrow local PR
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and ask for an equivalent maintainer-owned CSS parity PR with browser proof.

options.title: Reject the parity fix
options.body: Keep the issue open only if maintainers believe the real defect is virtual-scroll recycling rather than the source-visible sidebar CSS mismatch.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR first
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/744, require real Web UI proof, and land it if the proof and merge state are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main UI reorganization history makes steipete the best available routing owner for choosing whether to adopt or replace the linked PR.
